task: Implement evidence-driven advisory playbook activation so operators approve policy/thresholds once and the CLI activates only candidates whose lineage, recommendation, exposure, outcome, digest, and rollback evidence satisfy the contract.
outcome: When a qualified candidate exists, running lattice playbook_auto_promotion_apply --apply --json returns activatedCount: 1, lists the activated playbook id, keeps authority: non_authoritative and gateEvidence: false, and playbook_runtime_consumption_verify --json shows that active playbook is consumed while ineligible candidates remain blocked with explicit reasons.
facts: B-9958 completed seed observe, batch proposal, candidate approval, outcome recording, promotion sweep, and runtime verification.
Current playbook_auto_promotion_apply is guard-only: activationImplemented is false and --apply throws even when guards pass.
Manual playbook_activate exists but requires a human to pick candidate ids and digests one by one.
Playbook learning artifacts are advisory and non-authoritative; they must never satisfy story DONE, review, or receipt gates.
DONE success alone must never count as helped evidence for activation.
constraints: Do not use an always-off environment flag as the ordinary activation boundary.
Require reviewed activation policy and qualifying evidence before --apply writes active status.
Preserve digest binding and idempotency so stale candidates or repeated applies cannot corrupt playbooks.
Keep active playbooks advisory and reversible; never delete candidate/outcome/decision evidence.
unknowns: Whether existing promotion decision rows contain enough digest material for idempotent activation or need a new activation audit row shape.
Whether rollback should be implemented as a status change command, a demotion recommendation, or both.
Whether the existing smoke has reusable fixtures for constructing candidate/outcome/decision rows.
